title: The First Blood
summary: Ha-Jun's blood awakens the dormant Mythic Relic. As Kuro's feather bonds to his flesh, his right arm mutates into a crystalline demonic gauntlet and the Sovereign System awakens—drawing the first Lesser Imp through a spatial tear on the rooftop.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's trembling pale hand clutching Kuro's obsidian feather, fresh scarlet blood dripping from his punctured palm onto the glossy black plumage.
The instant human blood touches the feather's quill, vibrant neon-violet and crimson magical flames burst to life without producing any smoke.
Ha-Jun's eyes snapping wide in disbelief, radiant violet fire reflecting in his wide dark pupils.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Y-Yeh aag...?! Yeh jal nahi rahi...!

panels.action: The solid feather liquefies into ethereal violet-black plasma, wrapping like living molten silk around Ha-Jun's bleeding fingers.
A glowing violet tendril of liquid mana sinks directly into the open cut on Ha-Jun's palm, entering his bloodstream.

dialogue.text: Pehle hi sparsh mein... sadiyon ka bandhan jud gaya.

panels.action: Ha-Jun shouting in panic, violently shaking his right arm to fling the feather off, but the black-violet plasma clings stubbornly to his skin.
A violent 360-degree radial blast wave of violet mana erupts from his hand, blasting falling rain droplets outward in a circular ring.
Distant panoramic view of the metropolis at night: Above Saint Mirren University, a brief vertical pillar of invisible demonic energy pierces the storm clouds.

dialogue.text: Ek aisi taqat jo sadiyon se so rahi thi... achanak jaag uthi.

panels.action: Ha-Jun crashes back onto his knees on the wet rooftop, clutching his right forearm as thick violet veins bulge visibly under his pale skin.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: AHHH...!! MERA HAATH... JAL RAHA HAI!!

panels.action: Ha-Jun gritting his teeth so violently that a bead of blood trickles from his split lip, neck tendons taut with agonizing pressure.
Sharp, jagged purple-black crystalline plates click into existence over his knuckles and fingers, encasing his hand in demonic armor.
White restorative steam hisses from Ha-Jun's cheek and forearm. The bullies' deep bruises and cuts seal and vanish in seconds.
Stylized internal vision: Deep inside Ha-Jun's chest, an ancient obsidian seal fractures, releasing a glowing violet core of Demon Sovereign power.

dialogue.text: Sovereign ki pehli seal toot chuki thi.

panels.action: Full reveal of Ha-Jun's right arm: Transformed into a majestic, crystalline purple and black Demonic Gauntlet with pulsing neon-violet mana circuits.
Ha-Jun panting heavily, one demonic gauntleted hand pressed onto the cracked wet concrete floor, rain beating against his shoulders.
Extreme close-up: Ha-Jun raises his head. His dark brown pupil has transformed into a glowing, slit-pupil demonic violet ring.
Perception slows down: Falling raindrops appear suspended like glass beads in mid-air around Ha-Jun as supernatural sensory acceleration kicks in.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Sab kuch... itna dheere kyun ho gaya?

panels.action: Geometric obsidian holographic shards fracture into existence in the air directly in front of Ha-Jun's face.
A floating dark-glass system window appears glowing with crisp violet typography: [ALERT: DEMON SOVEREIGN BLOODLINE DETECTED].
Ha-Jun staring with wide, bewildered eyes at the hovering system window, rain droplets sliding down his cheeks.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh... koi video game ki screen hai kya?!

panels.action: Close-up on system screen: [SYNCHRONIZATION: 1.2%] | [RELIC 1/10: KURO'S FALLEN FEATHER (MYTHIC) BOUND].
System screen flashes dark crimson text: [WARNING: THE SOVEREIGN'S SCENT WILL ATTRACT PREDATORS OF THE ABYSS].
Ha-Jun reaches his crystalline demonic gauntlet forward to touch the screen, sending violet circular ripples across the holographic glass.
The system window suddenly turns bright neon red, alarms pulsing: [CRITICAL: SPATIAL FRACTURE 10 METERS BEHIND YOU].
Across the wet rooftop terrace, space tears open like black cracked glass with violent purple lightning arcs dancing around the breach.
Thick, corrosive pitch-black demon fog pours out of the dimensional tear, hissing as it melts the wet concrete rooftop tiles.
From the swirling black miasma, multiple pairs of glowing sulfur-yellow multifaceted predator eyes glare out with feral hunger.
An 8-foot tall Lesser Imp demon steps onto Earth: Leathery gargoyle wings, razor-sharp scythe forearms, and a maw dripping caustic black venom.
The beast inhales the rain-soaked air, locking its glowing eyes directly onto Ha-Jun's glowing gauntlet with sadistic ravenous glee.
Grand cliffhanger: 17yo Ha-Jun turns to face the towering demon beast, his crystalline purple gauntlet flaring with brilliant violet mana in the pouring storm.
